data.title: gonum fork: check reported Dtrmm skip when alpha*b underflows
data.body:
Reported by the code-modernization transform agent during the MB01UD Go rewrite (teaching run, workspace ~/workspace/mb01ud-modernization).

Claim (modernized/mb01ud/MB01UD/TRANSFORMATION_NOTES.md:50): in plantcontrol.org/v1/gonum v0.20.7, Dtrmm Left/NoTrans "skips work when alpha*b == 0 and leaves b unscaled; reference BLAS skips only when b == 0". Workaround applied there: scale A by alpha while copying, call Dtrmm with alpha=1. Edge cases: modernized/mb01ud-transformed/edge_test.go:21-25.

Not reproduced yet: Left/Upper/NonUnit, alpha=1e-300, B=[1e-30] -> [0] (correct); 2x1 B=[1e-30,1], A=[[1,1],[0,1]] -> [1e-300,1e-300] (correct); Trans 1x1 -> [0] (correct). Repro program: scratchpad trmm/main.go (blas/gonum/level3float64.go Dtrmm ~L779).

Next: try Right side, Lower, larger n, and SIMD ScalUnitary/AxpyUnitary paths; compare with reference DTRMM; file upstream-fork fix + regression test if confirmed.
